items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I think he had written the number, either he or Fats Waller -- I don't know. Because they worked in collaboration with one another.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mmm-hmm. So we recorded it, and Andy did the vocal on it, too. I think it was his number. I think he had written the number, either he or Fats Waller -- I don't know. Because they worked in collaboration with one another. And he sang it, and just like that, just like you hear it, that's it. And that's about as far as I can go.
Razaf gets credit for being the composer.
